cases.query: What makes automation workflows difficult for beginners?

sources.text: Automation workflows connect triggers to actions. They can include conditions and retries.
A separate technical reference about JSON and API requests.

Automation workflows connect triggers, data and rules to outcomes. Beginners often struggle with JSON, API authentication, field mapping, errors and retry behavior. A basic form-to-CRM automation may not require custom code.
A separate technical reference about JSON and API requests.
